Messages.Author: theventrue
Messages.Body:
1. A minion equips with a unique weapon
2. That weapon is contested
3. That minion is diablerized
What happens to the contested weapon? Does it go to the diablerist? is it
removed from the game?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


It is burned. The other copy (assuming it is the only other contested copy)
will be recontrolled during its controller's next untap phase, ending the
contest.
